product_name: Cynthia Dress - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy

product_name: Cynthia Dress - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy

product_name: Cynthia Dress - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy

product_name: Cynthia Dress - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy

product_name: Cynthia Dress - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy

product_name: Lancia Travel Dress - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue

product_name: Artemis Travel Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Gorgeous dress! I love the overall styling and the sleeves. The origami tech fabric is always fabulous and it works especially well for this dress. It’s TTS for me - I took my usual size 6.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: Bought this as a Christmas gift for daughter. I can't review at this time.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_title: Is it a dress? A coat? A jacket? Yes
review_text: I got the maroon in size 2. I usually wear 2 or 4 in dresses. Fabric has a bit of give and ample allowance of the backside when belted. I like the formality and timeless structure and always in market for dresses with sleeves. A keeper. Might even pick up in another color.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: A lovely dress--so well made--and fit perfectly. Great length for me (5'5")

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: I love a wrinkle-resistant, multi-tasking garment for travel and this is perfect! I was on the fence between the new, longer version and this one but went with Olive since I wanted something that can go with black or navy for travel. As with everything MM LaFleur, the quality is beautiful. The fabric is the perfect thickness, not so thick that it makes you look bulky with it buttoned as a dress, but thick enough to work as a jacket. Very comfortable and not too short for me to wear without tights. This will work for a business event and also for daytime over a t-shirt and jeans. Tailored without being uncomfortable to raise my arms. I am 5'3" usually take a 6 or 8 in MM LaFleur, purchased a 6.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: Love the idea of a 2 in 1 piece and it being easy for travel and packing. The bummer- the arm length is a bit short for me and the next size up was huge. Unfortunately both sizes arrived super wrinkled. Seems contradictory to the design.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text:
I buy MMF for business travel. Travel clothes need to pack light, be wrinkle resistant and machine washable. 

This dress checks all those boxes and more. It’s versatile and can go from a dress to a jacket. It’s like having multiple outfits in one easy package.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_title: Fit was pretty accurate except for sleeves
review_text: I always wear a size 4 in most everything and this dress looks super sharp. The sleeves were very long and required alterations of nearly 2 inches. The fabric is spectacular!

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: This is a classic dress that would be perfect in almost any setting. As much as I love this dress and wanted it to work, it was a one-sided love affair. The bottom fit well—sleeves were an inch too long (fixable). The deal breaker was the top. There was was simply too much fabric in the bust/under the arms, so that it looked like bat wings….i think an inverted box pleat in the back and a more tailored bust would have worked better. Ah well, I moped all the way back to the post office, but back it went. 5’2”/95# Fingers crossed, it works for you!!

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_title: As fun as I had hoped!
review_text: Love my Gwynne dress in black! The fabric is dense enough to feel substantial yet also fluid enough to flow in the wind when I wear it open over pants. The short trench style gives it a sexy spy vibe. Appreciate MM adding 2" in length to more recent Gwynnes so that it isn't too short to wear to the office with bare legs.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_title: Great to wear as a jacket!
review_text: I wear this as a long jacket with the Foster pants. I'm pear-shaped, XXL, so I think it would be too short to wear as a dress. It is super comfortable and stretchy, yet it holds its shape. I'd love to have it in other colors.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_title: Unfortunately not an appropriate fit for short-waisted gals
review_text:
I had high hopes for this suit dress, as I look best in the same color/pattern from head-to-toe, with a cinched waist. Unfortunately there was too much length in the top half of the dress, so it did not fit properly and gaped at the V. If there was a petite version, it would be a winner.

I'm also incredibly disappointed I am only able to return the dress for store credit because it was on sale when I purchased. When I had scoped out the dress weeks ago I looked at the return policy and it was fully refundable. However, it just happened to be on sale when I purchased and sale items are apparently only returnable for store credit. There's not a single other item that would work for me, which leaves a bad taste in my mouth and a gaping hole in my wallet.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text:
I like the multifunction of this item. I was expecting better belt loops and better buttons for the price. I have an hourglass frame and also would have appreciated just a tad more volume by the bottom button of the cool charcoal color to make walking easier with it buttoned as a dress. 32dd, size 6 too, size 8 bottom, curvy, and the size 8 in this item fit well, no gaping. 
Please make more colors in the longer length with better buttons and belt loops.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: I had to size down because of availability. It's a snug fit on me, but still looks great. Love it!

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal

I will probably wear it as a dress mostly, but I tried it open with the Rachel underneath & that was cute too! This dress feel like a classic that will stay in my wardrobe forever!

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal

review_title: Chic and effortless, with an edge

review_text: I'm 5'3 128 lbs and got a size 0. The dress fit me perfectly. I wear it either buttoned-up as a stand-alone dress or as a coat. product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: Familiar with the OrigamiTech fabric and honestly, though it's a great product, it's not my favorite from MM as I personally feel more confident in a heavier/sturdier and more supportive textile. Also, as I'm not blessed with great skintone, the two offered shades aren't my best. However, loved this style and its versatility and really wanted to try. Not planning to be a heavy rotation item in my closet but a fun piece in warm weather. I went with my larger MM size (12), due to bust measurements, rather than my dress size and glad I did. It fit as intended. Yes, the excellent engineering prevents bust gap but the thin fabric still shows the slight tugging on the buttons below/at bust. Length is perfection. [Slightly longer than shown as I'm 5'8" and not 5'10" like the gorgeous models.] I like the look both as a blazer or dress with tights/boots. Not fanny-hugging. The quality is very good so far. Every stitch shows on this light fabric. (I will let you know how those bust buttons hold up though.) Shipping is always pretty speedy but be prepared to steam and or wash/steam before wearing. Definitely shop your shape here but a fun closet add!

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: These pants are amazing. They are comfortable and chic and feel so soft and non-constricting. I can dress them up and down and look all out together.

product_name: Allyn Kick Flare Pant - Butter Ponte :: Black

ps I am getting my original y Allyn in electric blue lengthened

product_name: Allyn Kick Flare Pant - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: These lighter weight ponte pants are one of my favorite things I’ve bought from MM LaFleur. The cut is flattering, the waist band is comfortable and sits on the proper spot, love the length and the flare. Hope they make more colors!

product_name: Allyn Kick Flare Pant - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_title: Surprised how much I liked these!

anyway -here's what I like - they are very comfortable and stylish without looking overly casual. the fit is great - no wrinkles around hips or knees. and the calf length with the flair is different enough from my other pants to make it seem really new. 

I hope that MM LaF gets these in another color!

product_name: Allyn Kick Flare Pant - Butter Ponte :: Black

product_name: Allyn Kick Flare Pant - Butter Ponte :: Black

product_name: Allyn Kick Flare Pant - Butter Ponte :: Black

product_name: Hart Flare Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black

product_name: Hart Flare Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Black
review_text: I love these pants. Combined with the Bluebell Rossi jacket, this is my new power suit. I get compliments every time I wear it. The pants are very long. I’m 5’ 7’’ and I had to have a good 3 to 4 inches hemmed. However, once I got them to the right length, they are perfect and this is the outfit I wear on the days I need the most confidence.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Black
review_text: Great fabric and color, and the fit is really good too. They arrived excessively long, so I have to pay to get them hemmed, and I'm on the tall side (5' 6"), so that was a little disappointed. Note that these are really big and flowy, so if you don't like that look, don't buy them.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Black
review_text: These are beautiful but they run small to MM sizing. I have 2 pairs of the Bia pants in size 4 and wear them very regularly and I also have the Milo jeans in size 4 (though I sometimes wish I had sized those up to a 6 for a bit looser fit). These I ordered up to a 6 and they were way too small. I returned for an 8 and they fit nicely now . So they are beautiful but run 2 sizes small. I also had to size up to an 8 in the matching Moreland Travel jacket and I am actually usually smaller on top than bottom. Always a Small or 2-4 in tops. It is great to have pants like the Bia and these in longer inseams though. These are just perfect for me at 5'9" and 138 lbs.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Black
review_text:
These trousers have a great style. The fabric hangs nicely and they are truly wash and wear. My skepticism turned to belief. Like all MM LaFleur clothes, the quality is high and the fabric lovely. I'm going to travel in these without worrying about wrinkles and washing.
The length is slightly long for my frame, so great for those gals with longer legs. We can always hem pants, but it is really hard to make them longer! The 8 is a perfect fit for my usually size 8 body.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Black

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Black

review_text: Perfect travel pant with a kick! Fit just like the original Foster and never bag or sag but still provide the room a stretch. Love them.

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: Love the new kick flare! Same great fit as the Foster at the waist and hips, with a fun flare at just the right spot. At 5’ 10”, these are cropped on me as on the models. Great with booties or flats (or heels if you wear them).

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: The best pants for petites who struggle with even the shorter length of the Foster - and a good replacement for those who used to love MM's Oshima. And look perfect every time after repeated machine wash + line dry!

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: I love these pants. I have Foster pants in mny colors the are the worhorses of my wardrobe. These Kick Flares make me feel cute, fun and sassy! I love how they fit and feel. My new favorites.

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: Cute for summer

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_title: Excellent quality, waist too high for me
review_text: I was so excited to receive the Kick Flare Foster Pant. Bone color is the perfect light neutral color and the style is probably flattering to most women. Unfortunately, I have a short torso (short waisted) and they came up too high to be flattering, leaving excess fabric in the crotch when I walked or sat down. Sadly, I returned them as I did not think they could be altered to resolve the problem. I would have ordered multiple pairs if this pant had worked for me, as the quality is top notch.

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: These pants are next-level — the fabric is luxurious and substantial without being heavy, and the interior details like the extra button to prevent gaping at the side zipper create a nice silhouette. I have short legs for my height (5’8”) and wanted a length that hit right above the ankle, so I hemmed 2” and they’re just right. I got the saddle color, which goes with literally everything.

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: These are so cute. Even better than the regular fosters which I also love. The kick flare adds just that extra bit of style. They seem to have a slightly higher rise which I also really like. I don't think you can go wrong on these. I have them in black and tusk.

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: I loved the Oshima pant. This style is indeed similar, but snugger, which is good news if you want to be held in more, but not if you don't want essentially tight pants. They're great-looking, just not for me.

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: I was so sad to lose the Oshima, my favorite ever MML pant and these are almost identical. The bone is a great color for spring and summer.

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: The Foster kick flared are wonderful: they seem to be better proportioned in the rise and waist than the traditional Fosters and remind me of the Oshima, but they fit better than those, too. (No need to pull them back up during the day,) I bought the saddle in my standard MM pant size, wore them the day after they arrived, and am already contemplating another pair. Well done, MM!

product_name: Kick Flare Foster Pant - Eco PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: A stylist described these as the "sleeper hit" of the spring release. Adorable, fun to wear. Tried them with the Twidwell jacket and bought both. Sizing was the same as my regular Fosters.

product_name: Foster Cigarette Pant - PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: I bought this pant in both black and bone because it's so flattering. Love the side zip. The fabric moves with you yet holds its shape, no baggy knees. Can be casual or dressy. Love that length can be shortened with ease. Hope dark navy gets restocked in my size because will buy that in a heart beat! Had to go up one size but didnt mind that for the perfect fit everywhere else. If you like the look of a slim pant, check out this piece.

product_name: Foster Cigarette Pant - PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: These are my favorite dress pants! I have 5 pairs in 3 colors (black, navy, and olive green). They’re stretchy enough to be comfortable and (accommodate fluctuations in weigh), but structured and sleek enough for the office. The fabric is breathable in the summer. Tried on pairs in lighter colors but returned - fabric is too lightweight - can see panty lines underneath. Love the side-panel zipper with the little buttons - very secure.

product_name: Foster Cigarette Pant - PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: Super practical for biz casual

product_name: Foster Cigarette Pant - PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: I really like the fit of the Foster cigarette pants. For me, I am usually a size 6 pants and in these, went with 8. I kept the black, returned the navy for store credit, because have so many navy pants.

product_name: Foster Cigarette Pant - PowerStretch :: Black
review_text:
Love the fabric and the look suzed up 2 sizes 😜 anxious to wear them on an international flight.
Helps me look professional and fresh.

product_name: Foster Cigarette Pant - PowerStretch :: Black
review_text: Best easiest most flattering pants.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: Love these so much and am very grateful I picked up a backup pair because I somehow lost my first pair and they’re sold out! These are the ones I reach for over and over again - even more than Milo’s!!

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: The Daria Jeans are the BEST. Because the fabric is stretchy, the high waist does not feel suffocating like other high waisted jeans. The short pant leg is also super flattering and easy to make look casual with sneakers or nicer with a short heal. My one complaint is that these jeans don't have the built in hem button as some MM Lafleur pants -- I'm 5' 4" and I need to "hem" to make the rise hit above my ankles -- but I found that a simple fold holds all day. I could probably iron them and make the fold last through washes, but who likes to iron, you know? I also LOVE the white color -- fair warning, you need skin colored undies underneath to avoid the weird flash of pink flowers or something. I will probably purchase these in other colors.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: I tried these on and immediately ordered the white pair. I wore them on repeat during a recent trip - they fit well, don’t stretch out, and have deep pockets. I also love the length: they show just enough ankle when worn with sneakers or flats, which is perfect for my 5'6" frame.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: So happy with these jeans. I have tried the Hockley, Sammataro, and Milo and this is the best fit for me. I am 28 waist, 38 hips (126 lbs, 5 ft 5) and the Daria size 4 is perfect for my shape. I wear the Sammataro in 4, it fits more like a legging. Hockley in 4 the waist was too big. Milo in 4 was too slim/straight through the hips. Daria is super comfortable and can be dressed up or down. Highly recommend for the curvy gals!

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: I can't stop wearing them. :)

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: Obsessed with these, perfect for curvy girls with hips bigger than the waist. Fits true to size.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: love these pants! replacing an older pair that went missing in luggage... long story. anyway, these are so versatile, fit my XL/16 figure nicely, can be dressed up or down. great for travel

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: Comfortable without being sloppy- perfection.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: This is my first purchase from MM LaFleur and won’t be my last. I decided to try the Daria pants and absolutely love them. They fit true to size, are very comfortable, and so flattering. I got several compliments on the first day I wore them and know I will be wearing these often. They’re spendy but worth it!

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: Love better than denim fabric and these jeans are another great cut. Very sleek and flattering. Ordered my usual MM size and the fit is good. The length is a bit shorter than I’d want but I can manage.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: I love the fit and feel of the Daria jean-- the fabric is thick while still being stretchable and soft. The style is versatile as you can dress it down for a casual weekend, but also wear to work. My only feedback would be the length. At 5' 7", most pants hit me at just the right point. But the Daria's length seemed to make it look like a "highwater" pant: neither cropped nor ankle length. I got it hemmed by an inch and it looks much better this way.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: I ordered a pair of Daria's when they first came out and didn't care for the fit. I decided to try them again when they were slightly restyled. This time I kept them, although it took me a few pairs to get the sizing right. I am normally a 12, but had to size down to a 10 in these. I have been wearing my ink pair on repeat and just ordered a pair in tusk. Note, I am an hourglass shape and these pants are roomy in the hip.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text:
I like the fit, the length and the color. These will be very wearable.

Warning - these are a bit see-through. I have a lot of prints and dark colors in my underwear, you will definitely need to find a color to match your skin tones because any very dark or contrast color will be seen - although it's not super but definitely there

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_title: I was skeptical, but these are great
review_text: I have lots of trouble with pants ( waist smaller than hips) and even many MM styles are not flattering on me. But these new, slightly revised-fit Darias are great. They are super comfortable and stretchy, fit perfectly, and are very flattering. I got my usual MM pants size, in ink.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: Perfect fit and style to dress up or down. Love it!

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_title: Tusk and Ink Darias fit amazing!
review_text: The Daria has been my go-to everyday jean since the weather has warmed this season. The fabric is stretchy and comfortable, and these jeans stay in place - no slipping up or creeping down through all daily activities! I ordered the black, tusk, and ink colors to try. The ink and tusk have an updated fit through the lower waist, hips, and thighs and they fit me like perfection! The black (original fit) in the same size was too baggy throughout, and looked sloppy, so they went back. My only request is for more hem allowance so us tall ladies can let out the length! These are super cropped on me (I'm 5'10", 150 lbs, 36-28-38). I ordered size 4 in the Darias, which is what I wear in the Milos. I'm a size 6 in the wool Hortons and Mejias. Would love to see a full-length straight jean for fall in the updated Daria fit. :)

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: Great stuff

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: I really was so happy with these pants. They fit beautifully and the fabric exceeds my expectations. The quality really is the best I’ve purchased from any manufacturer and I’m sure I would buy another pair of these pants. They are stylish and classier than any “jeans” I've ever owned!

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: This fabric is amazing. Perfect pants for travel, because unless I spill pasta sauce on them I think I can wear them every day.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: Haven’t worn them yet other than to try them on when first received but they were flattering. Hope I feel confident enough to wear off white and risk getting them dirty!

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: Nice fit in my usual size, good every day width. I would love a pair of this style in full length as well, but will get plenty of use of these during the summer months.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: I ordered these before a work trip and am so glad that I did. They are extremely comfortable but still look polished. I sized down one size. A minor complaint is that they are a bit difficult to iron, though I line dry instead of tumble dry which may help with wrinkles.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: I don't even want to call these jeans. They are perfect for less formal work days. They look so sleek and fit so well. I want them in every color. I'm a 14 in JCrew and Everlane and bought the 12 and they fit perfect. Try to catch them on sale.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_title: Nice but wish they were longer
review_text: Nice but wish they were a little longer. They fit nicely in the waist and hips for a curvy shape. I have the Milo in a 4 and these also fit in a 4. But as with the Milo, a couple of extra inches would make them so much better. Since most are adjustable up, adding a little to the initial length would be great. The tusk color was a little see-through but pretty. I’m considering ordering up a size to see if they hang a little longer but I’m not sure it will be enough. I’m 5’8” and about a 32” inseam. The Bia pants (my absolute favorite) are perfect. More longer lengths please!

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: I love these. I originally ordered a 4 but sized down to a 2. They are snug in the waist but loser in the butt and thighs. I love the tusk color. Such a nice color for spring and summer (likely fall as well). I am 5'3" and they are just above my ankle. A very "right now" look. I am thinking about getting black as well.

product_name: Daria '90s Jean - Eco Better Than Denim :: Bright Ivory
review_text: Both fit beautifully! Many compliments.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: These are great pants—high quality and stylish. I didn't end up keeping them because the legs were as wide leg in the thigh area as I would have hoped. Perhaps the style is supposed to be fit more snugly in the thigh but I was looking for a wide leg-fitting ponte pant because I prefer my clothing to be looser fitting.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: I’ll be heartbroken if MM doesn’t continue making these in other styles and colors. I wore them twice the first week. First pair of pants in this fabric that ACTUALLY look professional and don’t just say they’re going to. 10/10

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: These are the best pants. They look good and are comfortable. I have been searching high and low for good pants as it seems others are now so cheaply made that they are junk. I am 5'10" and a size 8/M and usually buy tall sizes. These are barely long enough with flats, which is an accomplishment, but I will probably let down the hem and make them an inch or so longer. these could probably be lengthened to a 36" inseam.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Draping of dress pants, comfort of sweats. These will now be my go-to for work travel. Hot matching jacket for a coordinated modern suit look. Love it.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Exchanged for a smaller size. The material is nice and thick and drapes well. Please make pants in short lengths!

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Love these pants although they are very long and need to be hemmed. I also have them in ash. They are super comfortable and don’t wrinkle.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Runs large. Size down

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: I love these pants. Great length and weight and versatile. Wish there were more colors.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Felt lovely. Super comfy. The wide leg wasn’t for me.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Ordered two jackets and three pants in light pints! Could not be happier with the fit and the fabric quality! Looking forward to wearing them and many future orders!!!! Thank you for the thoughtfulness throughout the whole process from design to delivery!!! Dana Senior

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: The run big but are high quality.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text:
Love the material. 
Easy & forgiving waistband (business in the front, party in the back).
PLEASE KEEP THIS STYLE & ADD MORE COLORS! 
Would love a neutral tan.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: The cut of these trousers and the weight and drape of the ponte fabric are beautiful and flattering. I love the flat front and the long, wide (but not too billowy) legs. What I don't like is the look of the elastic waistband in the back. While the front says grace and sophistication, the back screams toddler pants. There are better ways to do a stretch waistband. (See the Allyn pants in this same fabric.) And I would love to see a flat-front trouser like this in other fabrics (i.e. the washable wool twill) with a side zipper. As for the Jordans, I'm keeping them because the plusses outweigh the one minus. I know I'll enjoy them -- as long as I wear a top that covers the elastic in the back.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Yes of course I had to get them hemmed - only giants won't - but coupled with the Janette blazer this is a winning look. Added bonus of the seam down the front makes these special. You look sharp but feel like you're wearing sweatpants. Amazing. Run a tad large. I tend to be size 10 in MM bottoms, and these fit in 10 but I'm left wondering if I could have gotten away with an 8. We'll never know...

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text:
Absolutely love the fabric and style of the Jordan Trouser but they are way too long. I'm 5'8" tall and had to have them hemmed 2 inches so I could wear them with flats and heels. Otherwise, I could have only worn them with 3" heels. Plus, there was another 3-4 inches of fabric for the inside hem. Crazy. Who is that tall that they need a 33" inseam and another 3" in the hem?

Also, I normally wear a size 8 in MM LaFleur pants and had to downsize to a 6. The 8 were too baggy.

I kept the pants because the fabric is super comfortable and is truly wrinkle resistant, the style is perfect for work and looks professional all day (the pants don't sag or stretch out), and the sewn in crease down the front adds a nice detail. I will get tons of wear from these.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: These pants are really comfortable and look great. I was so so on the color when i ordered them, but it looks good in person and will be really versatile. It just stinks that now i have to pay more for tailoring. The notion of adding a ton of extra fabric at the bottom to account for different heights is not appropriate at this price point. (What happened to mm lafleur's complementary tailoring that they used to offer?)

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Absolutely love these pants. I am 5’8” and the length is perfect with a heel! The material is perfectly structured and flowy for wide leg trousers. I can’t wait to see how well these will travel in the coming months.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: These are incredible! Flattering, professional, and they feel like thick yoga pants

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Crazy comfortable, I hope they make them in more colors! Looked great with the matching blazer and comfortable enough I wore them for an all day conference and then the plane ride home instead of changing into leggings or sweats.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: These pants are super comfortable and flattering. I had to size down in them just as I did with the matching blazer. I'll need to get them hemmed as well, which I imagine will be the case for most people. I rarely buy clothes I need to have tailored because of the cost and inconvenience that involves. It would be great if MM offered different length options, or could offer to have the pants hemmed to specific length before shipping.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_text: Unbelievable comfy and flattering.

product_name: Jordan Wide-Leg Trouser - Butter Ponte :: Black
review_title: The Best Pants I now own
review_text: I purchased these recently and I am ecstatic, about the style and fit. How elegant and flattering, Would love to see these in different colors. They are stylish and classic. Worth the investment. I commute to two0- three days per week to my office in Philadelphia and even after a long stay in the car with lots of traffic, they hardly wrinkled, which is a plus when I have to go straight to a meeting.

product_name: Mejia Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy
review_text: I won’t know until I wear it, but I chose it for the fabric and the styling. I assume it will be great.

product_name: Zuri Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Black
review_text: Absolutely in love with these pants! The fit is impeccable—tailored but comfortable. I don’t believe there’s a more flattering pair of trousers out there.

product_name: Zuri Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Black
review_text: Comfortable and on trend - even for petites

product_name: Zuri Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Black
review_text: I normally wear a size 2 in MMLaFleur pants. The size 2 on these pants was way too big (I would have guessed they were a size 4 or 6). I would have exchanged for a 0 but it's out of stock.

product_name: Zuri Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Black
review_text: I was worried that these would dwarf me as I’m 5’3. I did have to have them hemmed but they are one of my favorite pair of pants. I love the silhouette!

product_name: Zuri Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Black
review_text: Beautiful trousers, with a dramatic shape. Unfortunately, the faced waistband does not work well for me, so I returned them.

product_name: Zuri Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Black
review_text: Love it!

product_name: Tali Breeze Cardigan - Tape Yarn  :: Tan
review_text:
I was looking for a professional looking sweater set to wear to work during the summer months. This doesn't have the level of polish that my work place and position require. I decided to keep it anyway as it will work well with white pants for going out to dinner in the warmer months and not freezing in the restaurant's air conditioning. 

Note to MM: I would really love more stand alone (not see through, not sleeveless) knit short sleeve work top options. Particularly in something other than white and black. I scour every new drop for an item that fits this need.

product_name: Tali Breeze Cardigan - Tape Yarn  :: Tan
review_text: I love this cardigan. It’s perfect for layering and has a light airy feel. My only feedback is the length compared to the shell- untucked together to proportions look slightly off. It still a keeper. TTS for me.

product_name: Teddy Breeze Jacket - Summer Pinstripe :: Navy/Ivory
review_text: Gorgeous fabric and perfect for adding a bit of polish to outfits in humid summer weather. I took my regular size for an intentionally oversized, breezy fit, but could have easily sized down one or two sizes.

product_name: Zosia Cardigan - Crochet Knit :: Black
review_text: I love this cardigan. The knit pattern detail is so lovely and the color is a rich, deep black. Fits TTS for me. The black is heavier weight than the ivory. I wear it in place of a blazer in the office and it looks amazing with jeans too.

product_name: Zosia Cardigan - Crochet Knit :: Black
review_text:
A very special cardi! Gorgeous… and they just brought it back in Black, for Spring /Summer 2025! 
It does run a tad small, sized up at my stylist’s recommendation.

product_name: Emery Safari Blazer - Porto Weave :: Black/White
review_text: I always seem to need a jacket to fly and this jacket was SO versatile. It looked great with black and gray slacks as well as my Filomina blouse in white!!

product_name: Emery Safari Blazer - Porto Weave :: Black/White
review_text: Fits perfectly and works right into the rotation easy to dress up or down. Looks polished as a suit and easy with jeans and separates

product_name: Tyner Director Blazer - Sharkskin :: Mixed Check
review_text: Great smart jacket! Goes with everything!!

product_name: Tyner Director Blazer - Sharkskin :: Mixed Check
review_text: So happy with this—a little long but lovely

product_name: Tyner Director Blazer - Sharkskin :: Mixed Check
review_text: Great jacket, fantastic color, but this chino fabric was just too rigid for me as I like a drapier blazer. I ultimately returned this because what I really want is a chocolate brown Yiyan. I was hoping this would be an acceptable substitute, but no. I took my smaller MM size in this one.

product_name: Athena Jetset Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Ginger
review_text: I bought this jacket as part of the suit (with the Lowen Jetset Pants) and I love both pieces. The color is beautiful, a touch more rust-toned in person, as opposed to a bright orange. The fit is close to the body and streamlined, but not tight (fabric is slightly stretchy). I wore it on a short commuter flight heading to a court appearance, and to court. It was super comfortable, did not wrinkle, and I received no less than five compliments. It fits true to size (I'm size 12, with a curvy/athletic build). At 5' 8", the pants are the right length for me to wear with flats or heels, which is ideal if you want to wear the suit when you are traveling. More colors in both the jacket and pants, please!

product_name: Ayla V-Neck Jacket - Stretch Denim :: Midnight Wash
review_text: Chic and good fit.

product_name: Ayla V-Neck Jacket - Stretch Denim :: Midnight Wash
review_text: I purchased this in the OrigamiTech fabric in Olive. It runs large. I sized down one. If my shoulders were not as broad/arms muscular, I would have tried sizing down two sizes. Despite that--it is a really cute and versatile jacket in a good neutral color.

product_name: Ayla V-Neck Jacket - Stretch Denim :: Midnight Wash
Kane Cropped Jacket - Stretch Denim :: Midnight Wash
review_text: Fabulous jean jacket that looks adorable with the matching Bari jeans and will be super useful thrown over dresses for a casual look.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: I love the fabric and color. It goes with so many outfits and hope to buy in other colors too. Comfortable to wear.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: I do like the blazer. Wore it to an official business event paired with a skirt. It was a hot and hit day but the blazer was comfortable. I likest he versatility of it and it wears comfortably

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: This suit ended up being more informal than anticipated. It is fine for the day of travel to sit on a plane or train, but isn’t appropriate for a business meeting. The jacket is probably better with a dress than with the accompanying pants.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: Love MM always…and this suit is perfect for everyday and especially for travel! Just wore to a conference, and just did a quick iron job on it before wearing it and I was good to go! Love it super comfy and I feel like a star in it!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: Love this suit. I get so many compliments when I wear it. The fit is perfect.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: love it- great fit! right weight

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_title: I was drawn to M. M.
review_text:
I was drawn to M. M. LaFleur's Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech because of how light-weight it feels (it's unlined) and its shape/drape. I had to have the sleeves hemmed for my petite arm length (I'm 5'2").

While I've had some trouble pairing it with black business bottoms, it works wonderfully with casual bottoms and over business casual dresses, especially unbuttoned. I think a fun, light-weight lining would be terrific for a pop of color when cuffing.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text:
Origami fabric is amazing. Jacket fits beautifully. No wrinkles when rolled up!
Machine wash is a huge bonus!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: Nice fabric was too small.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: So perfect for work travel. Fits well and feels like a comfy set of pajamas.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text: Great color and fit! Washable and easily wearable. I’m a fan!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Cool Charcoal
review_text:

review_text:
I really love this blazer. This is my first piece from the Interweave collection and it may be best described as a very elegant cardigan. It certainly looks like a blazer but it feels like a cardigan, likely due to the woven fabrication and the stretch. I think I will be able to wear it year round.

I love the style which is comparable to several very pricy options but I could not find anything similar with stretch anywhere else. I really like the fabric, which is a two-tone tweed with stretch. The "taupe" color is a soft warm beige woven with a crisp white.
For me, this is an investment piece. I wish I had ordered it sooner, preferably when they had more sizes available and they had the super fancy buttons. The new buttons are plain and have a bit of gold.

review_text:

Fits like a sweater/cardigan, material is beautiful, definitely more cream than ivory and the pockets just make it. Def not the jacquard like jacket I expected and more like a super elevated cardigan that I know I would wear again and again!

product_name: Porter Jacket - Interweave :: Black / White
review_text:
Gorgeous jacket-for me it was a MAJOR splurge. But I think I will get a lot of use out of it and I do love it. A great unique style and will be very versatile--can be dressed up or dressed down. Will be great for travel, too. The fabric feels really good (I haven't worn it yet) but when I tried it on, I could tell that it will keep me feeling very smart looking in a truly unique piece but very comfortable bec of the stretch fabric. Some have mentioned that the jacket should be lined given the cost. Normally I agree with this and have been disappointed when some non stretch skirts have not been lined. but with this fabric I think it would be impossible to line and keep the stretch.

I will have to have the sleeves shortened a bit, which is a shame given the cost of the jacket. I'm 5'6" and don't have short arms. I will also ask my tailor to add a snap several inches below the last button to keep the jacket looking more closed up at the bottom when I am wearing the jacket closed. Otherwise (though it is not pulling across the hips) it will open a bit and ruin the line of the jacket. (I also ordered it in ivory and it's lovely. But I will be sending it back as I'll keep the black and white tweed since I will get more use out of it. But perhaps if it ever goes on sale.... 

As is always the case--and I have no idea why this is the case--MM La Fleur sizing is completely inconsistent across items. I am almost always an XS in MM tops, blouses and sweaters. Once in a while I am a S in the same. In this jacket I was a medium I don't know why the company doesn't pay attention to sizing consistency

product_name: Cynthia Dress - Washable Wool Twill :: Dark Navy

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_title: I was drawn to M. M.
review_text:
I was drawn to M. M. LaFleur's Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech because of how light-weight it feels (it's unlined) and its shape/drape. I had to have the sleeves hemmed for my petite arm length (I'm 5'2").

While I've had some trouble pairing it with black business bottoms, it works wonderfully with casual bottoms and over business casual dresses, especially unbuttoned. I think a fun, light-weight lining would be terrific for a pop of color when cuffing.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text:
Origami fabric is amazing. Jacket fits beautifully. No wrinkles when rolled up!
Machine wash is a huge bonus!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Nice fabric was too small.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: So perfect for work travel. Fits well and feels like a comfy set of pajamas.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Great color and fit! Washable and easily wearable. I’m a fan!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text:
I’m in your largest size category so there aren’t always a lot of choices for me but this time, I struck the jackpot. I ordered four items and four items fit, looked good and I kept them all.
I’m particularly excited about the Moreland Travel Bkazer. Yay, it’s lightweight, drapes nicely and feels great! Arrived just in time for my next trip!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Very cute but runs small. I am usually a 4. I ordered up to 6 because I wanted it a little loose and it was snug. Ordered up to an 8 and it is still pretty fitted but works. Will be great for work travel.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text:
I didn't really believe that the Moreland Travel Blazer could be machine washed and come out okay. But now I am a believer. The style and tailoring are fabulous and it comes out of the washing machine just fine. Hang dry and wear. Amazing. I'm usually an 8 and the 8 fit me just fine. No tailoring needed.

This is my new go-to travel jacket. I love the Olive as a variation from the usual black and white travel wardrobe.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: This is my third Moreland. It’s not board room material, but fits well and is a great go-to for the business casual corporate environment.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: My favorite jacket - exceeding all my expectations. I’m transitioning my work wardrobe to Origami Tech. The fit and fabric is unmatched. The pockets are excellent. It looks like it was made for me and I get loads of compliments.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: It’s a bit long for petites but I like their bags too fabric weight for California weather. Most jackets get too hot and I have to wear one to work

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Great for hot/tropical climates. I wasn’t sure about the cut and the styling but the slight crop and pleat down the front are done well. It maintains a smart but still feminine silhouette. They’re in my weekly rotation and I always look forward to wearing them.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: I wear the blazer with jeans and a crisp, collared shirt—perfecto!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: I own this jacket in many colors…a smart fit, comfy and travels well!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: I don't think this fabric lends itself to a non-lined blazer. I love the color and the shape.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Great jacket. I got it in green and black. Perfect for going over tighter fitting pants/leggings or a long dress. The green goes really well with animal print and tan, and elevates the look. I hesitated on the green but am glad I got it. Great fabric for travel.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Fantastic jacket. The length is perfect going over leather leggings or a long dress. Gives the body a great shape. I bought it in black and green. Fantastic for travel.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Very comfortable, trim, nice deep color (which is not always the case with blue). Even though the jacket is lighter weight and flexible, it holds its structure. I have three and wear them regularly in my work as a litigator.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: I like the material a lot and I wish it had two buttons so it was a little more structured. I would love another jacket in this fabric.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Beautiful blazer, I'll be able to wear it with pants, dresses, even t-shirts for a more casual look

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: While I decided to keep the two pieces because I really love the fabric, I am not sure the fit is perfect! I exchanged my original order for a size smaller and the pants still “bag a bit” in the seat - both the pants and the blazer are having alterations so hopefully the fit will be improved. I used to order MM Lafleur constantly but am finding the prices higher and a little out of my range now! This was a splurge buy for me and I expected the fit to be better. Thank you.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Just received my third Moreland - love the navy (olive is also lovely and versatile color, if you're wondering). Perfect weight for warm weather, easy to layer when it's cooler, stretchy yet polished, love the zipper pockets that perfectly contain a passport and the pockets-within-pockets for an ID or credit card.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: This piece is so versatile and is the right mix of dressy and casual to go in either direction!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Love it!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: I got this through the Bento Box program. I was skeptical at first -- how can a blazer be feminine? But I love it. Somehow, it never wrinkles. The lightweight fabric makes it different in that it falls low on my 5'5" frame, but still is airy. The olive is a cool tone, so not that weird yellow olive that you often see. Great for many skin types.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Love it! Everything I’ve purchased from MM fits well, is comfortable, and is designed with a woman’s body in mind!!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Very nice jacket. I am a big fan of this fabric—seems perfect for warmer temperatures and as marketed, travel. The cut of the jacket also seems universally flattering. I love the cool charcoal color—finally a grey that looks good on me! I sized the jacket for my arms/shoulders (muscular), it isn’t too large elsewhere—I haven’t decided if I’ll need to alter it or not yet.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: I was hesitant to spend this much on this blazer, but then I ended up purchasing two and could not be happier. I travel about 70% of the time for work, and this blazer is packable, light, and looks put together, and makes it easier to pack for my work trips & even roll off the plane and head straight into a meeting. I think the material makes it read a bit casual, which is fine for the environments I work in. Also, highly recommend using the Bento service for sizing - everything I purchased fit perfectly, but wasn't necessarily my normal size!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Love this jacket. Color is gorgeous.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Well cut, lightweight, zipper pockets a smidge more casual than I wanted but overall seemed a great blazer. Returned because I bought it as a set with a pair of pants that didn't work at all, but next time I need a suit I'd definitely give it another try with different pants.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Ashlee, in the Boston store, was so professional and helpful. She made the buying experience lovely. I felt so cared for. The clothes wear and wash well. I appreciate the tailoring. My wardrobe is ready for all work functions.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: I LOVE this blazer. I was skeptical about ordering but EVERY piece your stylist chose for me was flattering and gorgeous. I'm starting a new job and feel confident I don't have to worry about my clothes. This one's a keeper and I will be ordering more.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Thank you thank you thank you for finally responding to the cries for this great jacket in Navy - its going with me on a trip next week!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue

review_title: M.M LAFLEUR is my new shopping addiction
review_text: The Moreland jacket is amazing! Perfect compliment to so many of my outfits. Look polished, while staying comfy. I have to say, I have gone for over 2 years without refreshing my wardrobe because the quality/price ratio of places I used to shop descended into the ‘fast-fashion’ realm and I could not find a replacement. Now I have found M.M. LaFluer and rebuilding my wardrobe! It’s the perfect balance of trendy/classic/polished/comfy/quality. I am looking forward to being a loyal customer in years to come.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Beautiful color (berry jam) and I love the fit of this jacket. Sizing has gone up in fall 2024 vs earlier this year and I think this new sizing makes more sense.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: I love the material and have three pieces in the green shade. This color was too deep for my skin tone. I was so hoping it would work.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: The Moreland has become my favorite jacket!! Love the color and fit!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Material is comfortable and suitable for warm weather climates. I love the side pockets with zippers.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text:
This is my first M.M. LaFleur purchase, and I am very pleased! The Berry Jam color is so rich and lovely, I ordered the Maaza dress and Elena pants in this color also. 
I am 5’2”, 120 lbs, narrow shoulders, and DDD cup size, and the small fit me almost perfectly. I’ll need to have the arm length hemmed about an inch. I wore this on the airplane and for a full day of workshops; it was comfortable and looked good from start to finish.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: This is my favorite jacket style -- I just wish it came in additional colors!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Love the color and it fits like a glove!

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Love the Moreland and the color. Stretchy and comfy and the pockets zip up. The only criticism I have is that the jacket was super wrinkled and creased when it arrived. Even with aggressive steaming it still has creases. Not optimal or consistent the MM brand and quality.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: Tried it on in the showroom and it was perfect.

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: This is the only jacket for me in the Texas summers. I misplaced the first one and ordered a second one. It’s the go to jacket to look professional while avoiding heatstroke

product_name: Moreland Travel Blazer - OrigamiTech :: Prussian Blue
review_text: So comfortable! I can finally focus on work instead of being restricted by my clothing!

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I love these pants. Combined with the Bluebell Rossi jacket, this is my new power suit. I get compliments every time I wear it. The pants are very long. I’m 5’ 7’’ and I had to have a good 3 to 4 inches hemmed. However, once I got them to the right length, they are perfect and this is the outfit I wear on the days I need the most confidence.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Great fabric and color, and the fit is really good too. They arrived excessively long, so I have to pay to get them hemmed, and I'm on the tall side (5' 6"), so that was a little disappointed. Note that these are really big and flowy, so if you don't like that look, don't buy them.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: These are beautiful but they run small to MM sizing. I have 2 pairs of the Bia pants in size 4 and wear them very regularly and I also have the Milo jeans in size 4 (though I sometimes wish I had sized those up to a 6 for a bit looser fit). These I ordered up to a 6 and they were way too small. I returned for an 8 and they fit nicely now . So they are beautiful but run 2 sizes small. I also had to size up to an 8 in the matching Moreland Travel jacket and I am actually usually smaller on top than bottom. Always a Small or 2-4 in tops. It is great to have pants like the Bia and these in longer inseams though. These are just perfect for me at 5'9" and 138 lbs.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text:
These trousers have a great style. The fabric hangs nicely and they are truly wash and wear. My skepticism turned to belief. Like all MM LaFleur clothes, the quality is high and the fabric lovely. I'm going to travel in these without worrying about wrinkles and washing.
The length is slightly long for my frame, so great for those gals with longer legs. We can always hem pants, but it is really hard to make them longer! The 8 is a perfect fit for my usually size 8 body.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Great & lightweight!

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: These are lovely pants - comfortable, washable and easy. They fit a little tighter around the pleats than the other pleated, wide leg pants (Zuri and Bia), so they pull a tiny bit, which is why I marked down one star. My advice is to try them on to see if they work for you.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I love the material I love the quality and the lining of the pan. Great job everyone!

product_name: Ayla Travel Jacket - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Chic and good fit.

product_name: Ayla Travel Jacket - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I purchased this in the OrigamiTech fabric in Olive. It runs large. I sized down one. If my shoulders were not as broad/arms muscular, I would have tried sizing down two sizes. Despite that--it is a really cute and versatile jacket in a good neutral color.

product_name: Ayla Travel Jacket - OrigamiTech :: Olive
