review_text: Perfect skirt for traveling

product_name: Cobble Hill Skirt - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Beautiful skirt for the office!

product_name: Cobble Hill Skirt - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: A very classic skirt. I love the side vents in the back. Looks expensive. Its a high rise skirt!

product_name: Cobble Hill Skirt - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Classic style and works great with the other suiting pieces. I love the dark navy color and got the matching Yiyan blazer and Smith trouser. I had to size up to accommodate my wider hips and will need to get the waist taken in, so I wish MM LaFleur offered curvy fit bottoms, but I expected some tailoring. My measurements are 36-30-44 and I got a size 14 instead of my usual 10 curvy or 12 regular.

product_name: Cobble Hill Skirt - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: It's tight at top so I bought a size 8, but after wearing it once, the rest of the skirt felt billowy and oversized. I should have bought a 6. I can exchange it because I wore it once, so I'm stuck.

product_name: Cobble Hill Skirt - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Lightweight, comfortable, lovely fit. Matching jacket makes a comfortable, easy summer suit.

product_name: Cobble Hill Skirt - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Got this to go with my Moreland jacket, which I love. It's a bit high waisted for my liking, but otherwise great.

product_name: Cobble Hill Skirt - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: As usual with MM LaFleur, this is all about the fabric! Lovely weight, wrinkle resistant and will travel easily. The fit was perfect, nice drape without being clingy.

product_name: Colby Travel Pant - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: great travel pants and great pants in general- with jacket that matches, this makes a great suit to take and wear anywhere. I had two of them on a 3 week European trip and they were great!! - pants alone with a sweater or pants and jacket as a suit in th evening- always felt “dressed” and no wrinkles. .

product_name: Colby Travel Pant - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I have several OrigamiTech pants and jackets and I love them for traveling and everyday. The berry jam pants, which I purchased on final sale, are gorgeous. The color is much richer than shown - so versatile with taupe, black, navy. Another addition to my growing collection.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Bought this as a Christmas gift for daughter. I can't review at this time.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_title: Is it a dress? A coat? A jacket? Yes
review_text: I got the maroon in size 2. I usually wear 2 or 4 in dresses. Fabric has a bit of give and ample allowance of the backside when belted. I like the formality and timeless structure and always in market for dresses with sleeves. A keeper. Might even pick up in another color.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: A lovely dress--so well made--and fit perfectly. Great length for me (5'5")

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I love a wrinkle-resistant, multi-tasking garment for travel and this is perfect! I was on the fence between the new, longer version and this one but went with Olive since I wanted something that can go with black or navy for travel. As with everything MM LaFleur, the quality is beautiful. The fabric is the perfect thickness, not so thick that it makes you look bulky with it buttoned as a dress, but thick enough to work as a jacket. Very comfortable and not too short for me to wear without tights. This will work for a business event and also for daytime over a t-shirt and jeans. Tailored without being uncomfortable to raise my arms. I am 5'3" usually take a 6 or 8 in MM LaFleur, purchased a 6.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Love the idea of a 2 in 1 piece and it being easy for travel and packing. The bummer- the arm length is a bit short for me and the next size up was huge. Unfortunately both sizes arrived super wrinkled. Seems contradictory to the design.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text:
I buy MMF for business travel. Travel clothes need to pack light, be wrinkle resistant and machine washable. 

This dress checks all those boxes and more. It’s versatile and can go from a dress to a jacket. It’s like having multiple outfits in one easy package.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_title: Fit was pretty accurate except for sleeves
review_text: I always wear a size 4 in most everything and this dress looks super sharp. The sleeves were very long and required alterations of nearly 2 inches. The fabric is spectacular!

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: This is a classic dress that would be perfect in almost any setting. As much as I love this dress and wanted it to work, it was a one-sided love affair. The bottom fit well—sleeves were an inch too long (fixable). The deal breaker was the top. There was was simply too much fabric in the bust/under the arms, so that it looked like bat wings….i think an inverted box pleat in the back and a more tailored bust would have worked better. Ah well, I moped all the way back to the post office, but back it went. 5’2”/95# Fingers crossed, it works for you!!

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_title: As fun as I had hoped!
review_text: Love my Gwynne dress in black! The fabric is dense enough to feel substantial yet also fluid enough to flow in the wind when I wear it open over pants. The short trench style gives it a sexy spy vibe. Appreciate MM adding 2" in length to more recent Gwynnes so that it isn't too short to wear to the office with bare legs.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_title: Great to wear as a jacket!
review_text: I wear this as a long jacket with the Foster pants. I'm pear-shaped, XXL, so I think it would be too short to wear as a dress. It is super comfortable and stretchy, yet it holds its shape. I'd love to have it in other colors.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_title: Unfortunately not an appropriate fit for short-waisted gals
review_text:
I had high hopes for this suit dress, as I look best in the same color/pattern from head-to-toe, with a cinched waist. Unfortunately there was too much length in the top half of the dress, so it did not fit properly and gaped at the V. If there was a petite version, it would be a winner.

I'm also incredibly disappointed I am only able to return the dress for store credit because it was on sale when I purchased. When I had scoped out the dress weeks ago I looked at the return policy and it was fully refundable. However, it just happened to be on sale when I purchased and sale items are apparently only returnable for store credit. There's not a single other item that would work for me, which leaves a bad taste in my mouth and a gaping hole in my wallet.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text:
I like the multifunction of this item. I was expecting better belt loops and better buttons for the price. I have an hourglass frame and also would have appreciated just a tad more volume by the bottom button of the cool charcoal color to make walking easier with it buttoned as a dress. 32dd, size 6 too, size 8 bottom, curvy, and the size 8 in this item fit well, no gaping. 
Please make more colors in the longer length with better buttons and belt loops.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I had to size down because of availability. It's a snug fit on me, but still looks great. Love it!

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: The fabric hangs better than expected based on the other reviews. I’m 45, 5’2” and 140lbs and got a size 8 (my normal size) and it’s perfect. I will probably wear it as a dress mostly, but I tried it open with the Rachel underneath & that was cute too! This dress feel like a classic that will stay in my wardrobe forever!

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Looks like a great dress, though it did not look good on me, unfortunately had to go back

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: High quality, cozy fabric, no wrinkles, perfect skirt length for a curvier frame. Look is both flirty and crisp, color is beautiful and classic. Wore as a dress for a night out to dinner and felt amazing. Love it!

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_title: Chic and effortless, with an edge
review_text: I wore this gorgeous dress to my daughter's wedding rehearsal dinner, styled with black stockings, platform lug-sole Chelsea boots and MM's wide croc-embossed belt, and received compliments the entire evening.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I think the key is finding the right size for this dress. I tried my usual size for dresses and it was not a good look. So I went up a size, and changed the color from olive to black, and it fits and looks much better. I love the dual purpose too. I love all things Origamitech so this dress is a great addition to my wardrobe that I will wear for special occasions and more casual ones too.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: It is fitted and has a bit of give in the fabric, which is nice. I would have liked better quality belt loops, though - sewn loops rather than the flimsy string for small belts.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_title: I've been looking for a dress like this for ages
review_text: I've always wanted a Blazer dress and finally found the perfect one. This is high quality and fits like a glove. Fits true to size and can be dressed up or down. I'm obsessed and will be coming back!

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I'm 5'3 128 lbs and got a size 0. The dress fit me perfectly. I wear it either buttoned-up as a stand-alone dress or as a coat. The fabric feels soft and has a bit stretchiness, which I like. The only thing is the about the buttons, some seem loose when the dress arrived and I had to do a bit of work around. But overall, I love how I look in this dress!

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Familiar with the OrigamiTech fabric and honestly, though it's a great product, it's not my favorite from MM as I personally feel more confident in a heavier/sturdier and more supportive textile. Also, as I'm not blessed with great skintone, the two offered shades aren't my best. However, loved this style and its versatility and really wanted to try. Not planning to be a heavy rotation item in my closet but a fun piece in warm weather. I went with my larger MM size (12), due to bust measurements, rather than my dress size and glad I did. It fit as intended. Yes, the excellent engineering prevents bust gap but the thin fabric still shows the slight tugging on the buttons below/at bust. Length is perfection. [Slightly longer than shown as I'm 5'8" and not 5'10" like the gorgeous models.] I like the look both as a blazer or dress with tights/boots. Not fanny-hugging. The quality is very good so far. Every stitch shows on this light fabric. (I will let you know how those bust buttons hold up though.) Shipping is always pretty speedy but be prepared to steam and or wash/steam before wearing. Definitely shop your shape here but a fun closet add!

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Loved the fabric and overall look. Runs a little big and top didn’t lay flat when buttoned.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I finally bit the bullet and bought the Gwynne Dress in Olive! I’m 160# and 5’6”, and bought my usual size 6. Love it as a long jacket (which is what I bought it for)! A bit tighter in the shoulders though

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I absolutely love this dress and this material. Perfect fit. I am 5’8”, 130# and bought the size 2. I love the inside button at the chest - it helps with gaping and creates a seamless look. Highly recommend.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Love this dress.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: The fit is fabulous and I love the dress however, one of the buttons immediately fell off upon wearing so it doesn’t seem as well-made as usual. Also, it’s a bit on the short side for office wear.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I love this dress. It is petite friendly, fits so comfortably and looks great used as a jacket. Great quality easy to care for material.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I love the idea of a coat dress. The fabric for this one is insubstantial though, and I’m not sure it would wear well.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I love this fabric. I was concerned about the shortness of this dress but figured I could wear it as a jacket to compliment my other pieces. Wow! Even on this 60 year old, it is fabulous as a dress as well. I’m 5’4” and weigh 125 lbs and a little short waisted and the 6 fit perfectly.

product_name: Gwynne Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Dress and coat?!? Yes, please. Gorgeous dress (and coat), very well made, beautiful fabric. I'm 5'1", but the dress felt a bit short. Worn as a coat, it felt too long and voluminous. Double breasted usually feels too voluminous on my short and stubby body.

product_name: Maaza Travel Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: This is my first Mazaa in the Origami Tech fabric, and I love how comfortable this dress is. I wish there would be more colors. Please make the Mazaa also in Prussian Blue!

product_name: Maaza Travel Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Professional and comfortable dress. Great length just above knee (5’5”). Love the stretch, the pockets and that it is machine washable. I have two of the Maaza dresses and one Lancia dress. I’ve switched my entire work wardrobe to Origami Tech.

product_name: Maaza Travel Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Very elegant and flattering style, quality fabric.

product_name: Artemis Travel Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: The fabric is essentially athletic fabric in the best way: a much cooler & more comfortable dress for summer that would also work for other seasons. It has some stretch and fits my shoulders and arms (often a struggle).

product_name: Artemis Travel Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Gorgeous dress! I love the overall styling and the sleeves. The origami tech fabric is always fabulous and it works especially well for this dress. It’s TTS for me - I took my usual size 6.

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I love this dress. I’m 5’10” and it hits at mid calf. The fabric is smooth and lightweight and the color is lovely. I know I’ll get a lot of wear out of this piece!

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I expected a better quality in fabric. I was disappointed but noticed that the dress was well made.

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Good fit. Beautiful color

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I’m 5’9” 150 lbs (ordered size 6) and love the length of this dress, feels professional and elegant. The linen is great for warm summer commutes to the office. The plaque of fabric inside the dress where the buttons stopped kept getting caught on my knees when I walked, which was annoying, so had a tailor tack it down along with taking in the bust a bit. Overall a good dress to pick up in sale

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: High quality product, love the neckline and the ability to wear open or buttoned. However, it runs really small in the bust. Tried two different sizes, and still didn't fit, and the second size was too large in the waist/hips. If you are larger busted, not the item for you. But didn't want to ding it too hard since it is a lovely piece, just didn't fit me

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: This dress is like a chameleon — it can be formal with heels or casual with sneakers, it can be a dress or a vest or a jumper with a long sleeve T underneath. Pricy but worth it — I got the green for work and just picked up the orchid for the four weddings we have this summer!

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Love this item - elegant, flattering, comfortable. Also can be dressed up or down. The only thing I don’t love is that the front doesn’t lay completely flat — perhaps if it were lined this would help with the collar area not showing through.

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Felt like it was proportioned for a tall person, which I am not (5'2"). Other than that, this would be a fun dress to wear but I returned it.

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I was worried about this style being a bit too long for a petite but it turns out it’s the perfect length. I love that it can be a long vest or a dress depending on my mood. I’d love to see it in black!

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_title: GET IT! Unique and expensive looking piece
review_text: GORGEOUS. Big fan of layering open over a black tank and pant for a sleeveless trench kind of look. High quality material and lovely fit.

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text:
Absolutely love this dress! So unique and elegant yet casual enough for just about everything.
The fabric is light yet feels sturdy for traveling. Material feels wrinkle resistant even though I haven’t tested the dress for work stress sweats, nor on the weekend yet for family runs, and all the squatting I do with a toddler around.
Planning on wearing it soon but absolutely love the unique cut and style. The army green is a sophisticated deep algae green not a cheap camo green.
So excited about this one truly. Please make more unique styles in midi length. Love pieces I can add to for an elevated look or keep as is for more casual events.
I purchased size 10 and feel I might get away with downsizing to an 8. There’s about 1-2 inch stretch in the waist. But I like how comfortable it fits in a 10 and know I’ll wear it much more for work & weekends if it has room to enjoy pasta and wine in. 
My measurements are 38 bust, 32 waist, 42 hips. I’m slightly more pear shaped than hourglass but because of my wide shoulders and thick arms this style fits like an hourglass; it skims the contour of the body beautifully. The tailoring is excellent. I’m 34G bra size and there’s no gaping in the top with this dress. A must have for busty gals.

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Perfect fit and can be worn for work and lunch with friends

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I LOVE THIS DRESS. I bought this after seeing the capsule with Anh Sundstorm, where she paired it with the white Milo jeans. I got so many compliments on the neckline in particular - so flattering. I love that it is machine washable and doesn’t wrinkle! Very practical for travel. The fit is true to size.

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Love this dress! Quality fabric and love all the features.

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: got this in olive and absolutely love the color. I'm a big fan of the OrigamiTech fabric - it works well for me for work and easy care. I find the fit forgiving for my pear-shape (I usually stay away from straight cuts).

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Love love love this dress. Beautifully made with thoughtful tailoring and shaping details throughout. I’m 5’2” and didn’t feel the need to make any alterations. Love the cut through the upper body (just enough shoulder and v neck to be subtly sexy but appropriate in almost any setting) and the elastic gathering at the back that lends shape and ease. Blush color is lovely and fabric has just the right structure and lightness for warmer months. Stop debating and buy this now before it sells out!

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_title: Nice dress, sizing and color off
review_text: It was very well made. Color was faded relative to the photo. However, the sizing was just too large for 0P and would require significant tailoring. I have most of my work clothes (suits and dresses, tops usually ok) tailored, but between the price point and faded color, I opted to return. I would repurchase MM Lafleur if near a store to try items on, but I would not purchase online again. I have had better luck purchasing workwear from other retailers online initialed J.C. & T and designer J.W. in terms of sizing and/or similarity of online images to item in real life.

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: I gave this dress five stars even though I didn't end up keeping it because I love all the OrigamiTech pieces so much. This dress was a little more formal looking than I needed right now, and I would have had to sew the back slit down a bit as it came up very high on me (I have a long torso). Honestly I wasn't sure why there was a back slit at all because the front provides room to walk... Anyway, I tried this dress in both my normal size 6 and a size 4. The 6 seemed a little roomy but I think that's the way it's supposed to fit. The 4 was too snug and the buttons gaped some. This dress would be amazing for a more formal office look, but I had to return which I found very quick and easy with MM's Happy Returns process! Size reference: I'm 5'10", 150 lbs, 36-28-38 measurements, and usually a 6 in MM dresses.

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Beautiful dress in both cut and color. It is flattering in every way, particularly because the material is a bit heavier and sturdier than expected (in a good way).

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_title: Blush color didn't work for me, love the dress!
review_text: I loved this dress in the olive so I thought I'd love it in the blush. The color wasn't flattering to me so I returned it. I wear this dress a lot though!

product_name: Cassandra Dress - OrigamiTech :: Olive
review_text: Would love to see this in all the colors of origamitech (and would absolutely love a navy origamitech material for all the pieces!). I've worn it with the matching Moreland jacket and without, got compliments both ways. I'm 5'2" and a 36DD and it fits me very well - and no hemming! I like to wear it with tall boots. The elastic in the back waist pulls it in ever so slightly to shape it to your waist without being tight. The arm holes fit properly and do not gape open to reveal a bra. The V-neck is not too revealing either. I have a work conference coming up with a presentation and I will be wearing this for sure! It washes easily in cold water and dries very quickly (overnight) on a hanger. I love love love the easy care of the origamitech line and it's my work wardrobe staple. Just wish the bags would come with the pieces like they used to.

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: This is my second Aniya because I’ve discovered the value of having a cropped jacket with great lines in my rotation, especially with dresses and high waisted pants. The measurements are a bit different than the first iteration and I’m pleasantly surprised that it still works just fine on my long-ish torso. The black/white crosshatch is a nice neutral that I can pair with navy or black. It’s that classic style that reminds me of (in a very good way) of my grandmother’s stylish outfits.

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Loved the color and the fabric. However, the shoulder pads made me look like a line backer. I returned it.

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Minor alterations needed as shoulders are too padded/wide and sleeves too long for petite frame but Bluebell color is gorgeous and length is great. Love the cloth buttons. Bought the pants to make a suit and it will be a great outfit for spring and summer.

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Gorgeous jacket! The color and craftsmanship are even better in person. It is true to size and exceptionally flattering.

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Needs a good steam and the sleeves shortened, but otherwise beautiful color and good fit

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Love this outfit!

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text:
GREAT cut. I love how this fits well on a 5'5" frame with a short torso and long legs. It does well to cover my shoulders for modesty, without looking stuffy. Great lining and solidly placed buttons. 
PLEASE make this in tweed!

product_name: Aniya Crop Jacket - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Gorgeous, elegant fabric. I found the crosshatch to fit slightly differently from the Lila Stretch tweed. It was slightly narrower in the shoulders and wider through the midsection, and didn't fit me as well, so I sent it back.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: I love these pants. Combined with the Bluebell Rossi jacket, this is my new power suit. I get compliments every time I wear it. The pants are very long. I’m 5’ 7’’ and I had to have a good 3 to 4 inches hemmed. However, once I got them to the right length, they are perfect and this is the outfit I wear on the days I need the most confidence.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Great fabric and color, and the fit is really good too. They arrived excessively long, so I have to pay to get them hemmed, and I'm on the tall side (5' 6"), so that was a little disappointed. Note that these are really big and flowy, so if you don't like that look, don't buy them.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: These are beautiful but they run small to MM sizing. I have 2 pairs of the Bia pants in size 4 and wear them very regularly and I also have the Milo jeans in size 4 (though I sometimes wish I had sized those up to a 6 for a bit looser fit). These I ordered up to a 6 and they were way too small. I returned for an 8 and they fit nicely now . So they are beautiful but run 2 sizes small. I also had to size up to an 8 in the matching Moreland Travel jacket and I am actually usually smaller on top than bottom. Always a Small or 2-4 in tops. It is great to have pants like the Bia and these in longer inseams though. These are just perfect for me at 5'9" and 138 lbs.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text:
These trousers have a great style. The fabric hangs nicely and they are truly wash and wear. My skepticism turned to belief. Like all MM LaFleur clothes, the quality is high and the fabric lovely. I'm going to travel in these without worrying about wrinkles and washing.
The length is slightly long for my frame, so great for those gals with longer legs. We can always hem pants, but it is really hard to make them longer! The 8 is a perfect fit for my usually size 8 body.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Great & lightweight!

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: These are lovely pants - comfortable, washable and easy. They fit a little tighter around the pleats than the other pleated, wide leg pants (Zuri and Bia), so they pull a tiny bit, which is why I marked down one star. My advice is to try them on to see if they work for you.

product_name: Rina Sculptural Pant - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: I love the material I love the quality and the lining of the pan. Great job everyone!

product_name: Bronny Cummerbund Trouser - Porto Weave :: Black/White
review_text: Fantastic style, but definitely order a size (or two!) up.

product_name: Emery Safari Blazer - Porto Weave :: Black/White
review_text: I always seem to need a jacket to fly and this jacket was SO versatile. It looked great with black and gray slacks as well as my Filomina blouse in white!!

product_name: Emery Safari Blazer - Porto Weave :: Black/White
review_text: Fits perfectly and works right into the rotation easy to dress up or down. Looks polished as a suit and easy with jeans and separates

product_name: Athena Jetset Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Ginger
review_text: I bought this jacket as part of the suit (with the Lowen Jetset Pants) and I love both pieces. The color is beautiful, a touch more rust-toned in person, as opposed to a bright orange. The fit is close to the body and streamlined, but not tight (fabric is slightly stretchy). I wore it on a short commuter flight heading to a court appearance, and to court. It was super comfortable, did not wrinkle, and I received no less than five compliments. It fits true to size (I'm size 12, with a curvy/athletic build). At 5' 8", the pants are the right length for me to wear with flats or heels, which is ideal if you want to wear the suit when you are traveling. More colors in both the jacket and pants, please!

product_name: Lowen Jetset Pant - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Ginger
review_text: These pants are super comfortable. I was hesitant because the fabric is crepe. I am so glad I did. Great fit for me true to size nice waistband and pockets. The ginger color is not too bright. Lovely for summer. I am a size 14 and love the fit

product_name: Lowen Jetset Pant - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Ginger
review_text: Gorgeous pant with a slimmer fit through the thighs and subtle flare at the bottom. The ginger is a fabulous, fun color. I sized up for a more fluid fit, but could have gone with my regular MM pants size.

product_name: Lowen Jetset Pant - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Ginger
review_text: I bought this suit for a big speaking event, and got a slew of complements. Color is fabulous, and I love the details like the snaps on the pants that allow you to adjust length without hemming. I don’t usually wear a jacket cut so long, given that I’m short, but worked well.

product_name: Lowen Jetset Pant - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Ginger
review_text: Needed a black straight leg pant that could do double duty between business casual and evening glam and this pant with the crepe fabric and top stitching suits both perfectly. Fits well, true to size, length adjustable for shoe height variable, will travel well because wrinkle resistant. Wish it were available in cream or egg shell for spring/summer. Very chic but also comfy.

product_name: Lowen Jetset Pant - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Ginger
review_text: Best Suit Ever!!

product_name: Rossi Executive Blazer - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: This is a great jacket for what it is – meaning a long jacket for a professional job. I purchased it because I had purchased the black pants earlier and decided I wanted a suit. The bottom closure when buttoned is a bit unusual – – an inverted V – – that makes it more smart, I guess. It just wasn’t my style and I like a shorter jacket. So I returned it, but it is an excellent jacket if that style is what you want.

product_name: Rossi Executive Blazer - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: First and second purchase was the blazer and matching pants. Absolutely beautiful and well made. On to my next purchase…. .

product_name: Rossi Executive Blazer - Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_title: Perfect jacket to grab and go
review_text: Love the length works great over slimmer skirts and pants.

product_name: Russell Button Down - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Love the fabric and fit of this shirt. Looks professional, but is very comfortable. Color is fantastic. Runs very large. I ordered a size smaller than my normal.

product_name: Russell Button Down - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Loved color and jacket. Returned for smaller size, much too big and hoping for right fit.

product_name: Russell Button Down - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: This Shacket style is a sleeper hit and a perfect addition to my power casual wardrobe. The wool is substantial yet refined, not too thick. I love wearing it as an easy layer over other tops for both warmth and style. It runs large, so went with a small rather than my usual medium. The color is absolutely gorgeous l, complements many others and will play well for most seasons. Perfect for 60 degree weather.

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text:
I love these pants, there aren’t very many styles I can wear without alterations but the Tessa is luckily one of those that fits just right. 
I love the fabric as well, it’s soft and beautiful and washable and the color is absolutely amazing.

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: I love these trousers! I bought the Rina Sculptural Pant to go with the Rossi Executive Blazer, but I like these pants with the suit jacket even better. I have an athletic/lanky build and these fit perfectly. Material is gorgeous and I received many compliments on the color.

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Love the length and the color. These are my new faves!

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Great color and feel. They fit perfectly but I didn’t like how the pockets seemed to bulge, even tho they were not tight. I did size up as recommended. They went back sadly.

product_name: Tessa Kick Flare Trouser - Washable Wool Twill :: Bluebell
review_text: Wanted to love these pants, but they have pockets on the hips. I have hips. Pockets on the hips always stick out on me. I ordered a size larger, but despite being extremely loose, the pockets still stuck out. I can't justify the additional $80 in tailoring to get the pockets sewn shut and to hem them to a manageable length.

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: The quality of the blazer is great. The sizing is large. In retrospect, I should've exchanged it for a smaller size. I am 5'7" and 145lbs, athletic build. The size 6 on me is BIG. I recommend sizing down.

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: I

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Love it. I’ve been wearing it every office day since I got it. Crushed my presentation to c-suite in it

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: I really liked this blazer. I got a ten and it draped beautifully, not to tight. HOWEVER, I wanted to use it as part of a suit and there were not any matching pants that I could find

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Nice and light-weight. The fit is definitely on the boxy side. Looks good with the pants and the dress.

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Great overall looking pants, love the feel and the cut. The waistband is very stiff and if you have a short waist (like I do) it is uncomfortable.

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: I wasn't expecting to keep this but I really like how thick the knit suiting is, and the plaid adds style without being loud. I'm 5'3" 130lbs and the size 2 is most comfortable for me, though snug enough in the arms that i wouldn't wear a long-sleeve under.

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: The O’Hara Everyday Crepe with Topstitch is in serious contention for the status of BFF blazer. The combination of the flattering O’Hara cut, fabric, and topstitching details make it comfortable, flattering, and fun. I’ve been grabbing it for those moments when I want to feel extra polished but still comfortable.

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Awesome jacket; this is my third O'Hara. The Black Everyday Crepe dresses up and down beautifully. The cut is both classic and modern, with tailored shoulders and a straight cut through the middle. It gives "boyfriend blazer" without being oversized. I order this jacket one size down from my normal MM Lafleur jacket size.

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: High quality, beautiful. The only reason for 4 rather than 5 stars is I’m not sure the cut is timeless. It is more boxy - but very current right now.

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: First day at big new job vibes! Especially loving the stitching. A must-have piece for every lady boss's closet.

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Great blazer for my black wardrobe! Stretchy! Arms were a big long but had tailored. Bought size 12 . . usual jacket size

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Cozy AF. The black and white check print is so cool, the fabric feels absolutely magnificent.

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: love the stretch, drapes well.

product_name: O'Hara Boyfriend Blazer - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: For is great in the shoulders which is a nice balance for the oversized fit

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: Phenomenal pants. So comfortable and flattering and travel/wear so well.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: MM does not disappoint.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: A great piece to add to your collection! The fit and fabric are beautiful - the feel and weight are luxe. My normal size fit perfectly. I've worn the culotte casually with flats and a sweater and dressier with heels and a blazer. I felt confident and professional, and very up to date. The MML clothes in my closet never fail me - I can always count on looking sharp!

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: These pants are exceptional. The waist is comfortable but polished. The feel is lightweight yet substantial. The look can transition from work with the matching blazer to more casual wear with a tee and sweatshirt. I find myself enjoying this style with the Para pullover. The care (machine washable) is awesome. The feel is lightweight yet substantial.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: These pants are amazing. They are comfortable and chic and feel so soft and non-constricting. I can dress them up and down and look all out together.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: Usually Travel items from other brands get pilling between the thighs and these don't do that. They were super comfy for a series of flights and could we reworn later in the trip with tennis shoes or flats, Happy with the color. Super versatile without being boring black.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: Love these pants and how easy they are to put on and style for work. Now need them in multiple colors.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: Lovely fabric but too long.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: These are my new favorite pants. So comfortable and way more flattering than I might have thought as a petite. I now have two pairs - one I hemmed to make them cropped as on the web site model; the other I have left in the original length, which hits me just below the ankle and is also flattering. I usually take a size 8 in MM pants, but I took a small in these and they fit perfectly. I have worn them to work with a jacket and weekends with sneakers. Can't wait to have them be travel regulars.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: Loved it but too big. Tried to exchange but Medium not available.

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: Love it!

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: This is my second pair of Elenas for a reason. The material is light and drapes nicely. The cut is flattering for my relatively tall pear-shaped body. The elastic in the back is subtle but makes this piece comfortable no matter what. And it has MM’s signature capacious well-designed pockets. Need I say more?

product_name: Elena Travel Culotte - Everyday Crepe :: Black
review_text: Beautiful. Classy. Great material and fit. As expected.

product_name: Carmela Streamline Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: I love this dress. It's elegant and classy. I am 5'7" and 145lbs. I ordered the 8 and it fits, but I think I probably could've sized down with no issues. Basically, it runs a little big, but not so big that I am swimming in it.

product_name: Carmela Streamline Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Love, love, love this dress!

product_name: Carmela Streamline Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: The lines, oh my. Simply a stunner of a dress.

product_name: Lancia Travel Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Flattering fit! breathable fabric good for all seasons of professional travel

product_name: Lancia Travel Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Love origami tech for travel. And it has pockets! Easy yet professional.

product_name: Lancia Travel Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
review_text: Loved this dress and excited to wear it. Flattering but modest cut. Ordered in size 16 and fit well in the shoulders and chest even on my busty frame. The everyday crepe fabric is stretchy and light but still feels substantial. Not a fan on the contrasting topstitch, but the black is still professional.

product_name: Lancia Travel Dress - Everyday Crepe with Topstitch :: Black
